lines.en: I flit over the grass tips.
My wings open and close, fast.
Daytime is my time.
I fly along the dandelions.
Black-edged patterns on my wings.

lines.zh: 我飞得歪歪扭扭，其实很稳
lines.en: I look erratic but I'm quite steady.
A gust lifts me half a block.
I rest on a blade of grass.
I know both the treeline and the plain.
Around that stone, then on.

lines.zh: 我的影子在草上一点一点
lines.en: My shadow dots across the grass.
My wings are tiring a little.
I fly low, hugging the ground for flowers.
Sun makes my wings bright.
I round another clump of grass.

lines.zh: 就这么飞，一天很快过去
lines.en: Flying like this, the day passes fast.
I rest on a flower and drink slowly.
I've coiled my proboscis up.
The daytime wind is warmer.
A dandelion will do me a long while.
Wings closed, I look like a leaf.
A bee goes past me.
I watch the meadow's movement.

lines.zh: 我的寿命不算长，也不算短
lines.en: My life is neither short nor long.
Someone approaches with a net.
I wipe my antennae with a foreleg.
This patch of flowers will fill my day.
I fan my wings once.
You're tall, and far above me.
Your net glints in the sun.
I fly half a circle around you.
Are you after me, or the flowers?
I land on your cuff.

lines.zh: 你的手一动，我就起来了
lines.en: Your hand moves and I'm up.
You smell of earth.
I'm not afraid, but I keep my distance.
I tilt my antennae.
Let's each go about our business.
A corner of my wing is crumpled.
I drop into the grass and climb out.
A coat of dust is gone from my wings.

lines.zh: 翅膀破了一角，我飞得歪。
lines.en: A corner of my wing is torn; I fly crooked.
My antennae are bent.

lines.zh: 这一下把我拖慢了许多
lines.en: That slowed me down a great deal.
I rest on a leaf, panting.
My wings keep trembling.
I'd like one more loop.
Not a second one, please.
Dandelions. Exactly what I want.
Is this one freshly opened?
There's sweetness. I'll go see.
The flower in your hand is wilting.
I'll settle and take a sip.
And I'll pollinate it for you.
Hold still until I'm done.
This one smells sweeter than the meadow's.
Just hold the flower steady.
I'll drink and go. No debt.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到了我的翅
lines.en: Your finger touched my wing.
The touch rolls me over.
I land in the grass with a creased wing.
Don't net me. It damages wings.
I skim past the net's rim.
That left me flying crooked.
I come back and land again.
Your shadow covers the flower.
One more touch and I'm off.

lines.zh: 翅粉留在了你的指甲上
lines.en: Wing dust stays on your nail.
This meadow is enough for two.
We'll circle the same flower clump.

lines.zh: 我的大翅膀，只在森林里张。
lines.en: My big wings open only in the forest.
Follow me. Don't get lost.

lines.zh: 太阳落之前，我们再飞一圈
lines.en: Before sunset, one more loop.
My wings are getting worn.
But they'll last with you a while.
For eggs, we need sturdy leaves.
These trees are tall enough.
Let's stay at this treeline.
My feet only clamp onto flowers.
I can't carry things from the ground.
All I collect is pollen.
This is too heavy for me.
I settle beside it and look.
Keep it. I don't need it.

lines.zh: 有网在，我什么也拿不了
lines.en: With a net out, I can't take anything.
I take it for a stone.
If it's not a flower, I won't touch it.
I've got another flower to visit.

lines.zh: 我身上没有能攻击的部件
lines.en: I've no part of me made for attacking.
Net up, I look upward.
I'm about to climb.
Too open here. Nowhere to hide.
I'll head for the tall grass.
Is your net faster than me?
I'm not fast, but I'm nimble.
You move, and I take off.
I'd rather not play this chase.
I just want to keep drinking nectar.
You've turned with me twice.
I retreat a bit toward the treeline.
Your hand hasn't come down.
The wind will help me turn.
To catch me, you'd have to aim true.
I land on a flower to test.
You've closed half a step.
Wings up, I can leave anytime.

lines.zh: 这片草地太大，你追不完
lines.en: This meadow's too big to chase me across.
That's enough. Stop chasing.
I hit your net and my wings go numb.
My wing sweeps your hand.
That's hardly even a breeze.
I slip out between your fingers.

lines.zh: 翅粉撒了一点在你袖上
lines.en: A little wing dust on your sleeve.
I'm not fighting. I'm struggling.

lines.zh: 我扑腾了几下，就落下来
lines.en: A few flaps, then I settle.
All my strength goes into flying.
A torn wing and I'm finished.
Don't hold so tight. I'd like to live.
I came out of an egg on a leaf.
By day, a butterfly joins the treeline.
My wings dried. I can fly.
These dandelions are just right.
I test my wings on a grass tip.
Good sun, and the flowers are open.
Forest or plain, either will do.
I need a freshly opened flower.
My black wing edges have just formed.
I lift off and head left.
The flame nears and my wings curl.
I hit hard ground and a wing folds.
Wings wet, I can't fly.
The blast sends me tumbling.
An arrow grazes my wing and tears it.
That light blinds me to the flowers.
No nectar, and my wings won't beat.
At the thunderclap I drop.
There's nothing around me anymore.
